name: Abigail
description: Spends rainy days in the mines and loves unusual minerals. A good friend if you enjoy combat, puzzles, and pumpkin-related gifts.

seo.title: Abigail — Explorer & Adventurer
seo.description: Spends rainy days in the mines and loves unusual minerals. A good friend if you enjoy combat, puzzles, and pumpkin-related gifts.

stardew.intro: Lives above Pierre's General Store with her parents. Curious, occult-leaning, and happiest when the day involves a sword, a game, or something purple.

heartEvents.title: Console co-op
heartEvents.summary: Help her beat a level of Journey of the Prairie King in her room at the store.

heartEvents.title: Rainy duet
heartEvents.summary: Find her playing flute by the mountain lake on a rainy afternoon — she invites you to play along.

heartEvents.title: Graveyard practice
heartEvents.summary: She's been training with a sword at night; a tense moment with Pierre leads to a quiet talk in the bushes.

heartEvents.title: Spirit board
heartEvents.summary: A late visit to her room turns into an awkwardly sweet moment with her spirit board.

heartEvents.title: Mines confession
heartEvents.summary: She's spooked in the mines and opens up about liking you as more than a friend.

heartEvents.title: Backwoods rescue
heartEvents.summary: After a monster ambush in the Backwoods, she saves you — and marks the spot where it happened.

routines.label: Regular day
routines.location: Room → Pierre's store → mountain lake (flute) → home

relationships.name: Pierre & Caroline
relationships.note: Lives with her parents above the store; Caroline worries about her hobbies, and Abigail pushes back.

relationships.name: Sam & Sebastian
relationships.note: Close friends — you will often see the trio hanging out around town.

trivia: After her 10-heart event, she may appear in the mines on rainy days to keep you company.
Birthday gifts on Fall 13 count for extra friendship — amethyst is a safe favorite.
